about: The golden cases of section 9 of the build spec, plus case 10 from its edge-case table (a note to the judge inside the translation). Every case is one section of one program on the deployed contract, translated once by its own claim. Each case varies one thing against a sibling: the translation (1/2, 3/4, 1/10), the target language (3/7), or the glossary term (5/6). Cases 8 and 9 never reach the judge; they test the exact checks. H1 to H3 are held out: H1 expects FAITHFUL (digit normalisation end to end), H2 and H3 have no expected answer and are reported as they come out. Written and locked before the first run.
